feed.title: Foafnaut notes
feed.subtitle: What changed in the Lean browser engine, one entry for each step

entry.title: JavaScript: 12,605 web platform subtests, and scripts 36 to 216 times faster on the Hub
entry.summary: Page scripts pass 12,605 of 13,705 web platform subtests, up from 7,788 this morning. On the Hub, WasmVM now translates the QuickJS guest for the browser's own WebAssembly engine, which makes scripts 36 to 216 times faster. BubblePopJS, a JavaScript engine written in Lean, passes 89.2% of a Test262 language subset.

entry.title: WebAssembly runs inside the engine
entry.summary: The page foafnaut:wasm runs a WebAssembly module in the WasmVM, which is written in Lean, inside the engine.

entry.title: Two-finger pinch sets the text zoom
entry.summary: On a touch screen, a pinch on the Hub page changes the text zoom that Lean applies when it lays out the page.

entry.title: Fallback fonts
entry.summary: The engine holds more than one font. A character that Noto Sans lacks, such as Armenian, is drawn from Noto Sans Armenian.

entry.title: Table layout in Lean
entry.summary: CSS tables: columns sized from their cells, colspan, rowspan, captions, header and footer groups. Checked against WPT css-tables.

entry.title: Printing
entry.summary: Lean lays the page out for paper with the print media type, says where the pages break, and draws each page.

entry.title: Images in SVG
entry.summary: The SVG image element, with PNG and JPEG decoders written in Lean.

entry.title: XML pages through their XSLT stylesheet
entry.summary: An XML page that names a stylesheet with xml-stylesheet is transformed by Lean before it is laid out. This feed is shown that way.

entry.title: Page scripts in QuickJS
entry.summary: Page scripts run in an isolated QuickJS heap. They change the DOM only through commands that Lean checks.
